issue.title: Six Refs* XCTests fail on every bob-mac-capture macOS CI run since the rename card and Highlights Tabs epics
issue.description:
Found by bob-cli-8b.land while separating epic-caused Mac CI failures from the pre-existing baseline. bob-mac-capture's macOS CI Test step fails on these six Refs* XCTests in every run from c2f9999 through 8e86b32 (runs 38906889451, 38915109255, 38918462775, 38920508536, 38921797357), and none is tracked by an existing bead (bob-cli-7p, bob-cli-7h, bob-cli-61, and bob-cli-67 cover other Refs tests; bob-cli-8e covers the template-area ones). They first appear after the bob-cli-7x rename card (9ac536c) and the bob-cli-84 Highlights Tabs work (94a4e58..1e2a9bd); both epics are closed.

Failures at 8e86b32 (run 38921797357):
- RefsFooterTests.testHintsCarryCopyAndScanShortcuts — RefsFooterTests.swift:15 footer hint string mismatch (the hint row now includes `⌘T Ta…`, the Tabs entry, which the expectation lacks).
- RefsInspectorLoaderTests.testCopyActionOpensCardAndCopiesItsSelectedRow — RefsInspectorTests.swift:602 "team_fit_review" != "today_report".
- RefsInspectorLoaderTests.testIntrinsicsDiscardDropsInFlightAndAllowsFutureLoads — RefsInspectorTests.swift:489 1 != 2.
- RefsPanelDesignTests.testRefsPanelStatesToPNG — RefsPanelDesignTests.swift:1200 XCTUnwrap RefsRowContent nil.
- RefsPanelModelTests.testRenameDuringScanFailsWithHumanBusyMessage — RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2278 condition timeout.
- RefsPanelModelTests.testRenameFieldPrefillsStemAndTakesFirstResponderWithTextSelected — RefsPanelModelTests.swift:374 XCTUnwrap NSTextView nil.

Impact: together with bob-cli-7p/7h/8e they keep master CI red, so Bundle, launch smoke, and install gates never run and new regressions hide in the noise (bob-cli-8b's own epic-caused failures were found only by diffing failure sets run by run). Fix each test or its production regression and confirm on a macOS CI run.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical assertion failures at the same lines in five consecutive macOS CI runs on five different SHAs (c2f9999, cb4c01e, 3300128, ee08ca7, 8e86b32); several are deterministic string/value mismatches (footer hint text, copied row id), not timing.

issue.creation_reason: Separating bob-cli-8b's epic-caused Mac CI failures required diffing failure sets; these six untracked Refs failures are part of the red baseline that hides new regressions.
